basic_tastes.description: Every item scored 0-3 on each. 0 = absent, 3 = dominant. The 'spicy' score was seeded from the spicy_warm flavour note (present -> 2, absent -> 0) when spice was added as a taste; the outlet should refine it to a real 0-3 per dish.

flavor_notes.description: Fixed enum. An item may carry zero or more. Assigned from actual recipe/ingredients, never inferred from the dish name alone.

image_convention: Each item carries image_url. null means no image yet and the client renders a placeholder. The backend fills this at deployment with either an absolute CDN URL or a path relative to the web root, e.g. "/images/M001.jpg". Files dropped into web/images/ are served at /images/.
